purpose: Four unique editorial lifestyle scenes for the Loja dos Signos HOME carousel.
tool: Built-in image_gen; one generation per scene with local referenced images.

direction.referenceRole: Approved references establish artistic language; the actual SKU mockups are authoritative for the printed designs and applications.

commonPromptBrief: Photorealistic premium editorial lifestyle photography, landscape 3:2, warm natural light, matte handmade atmosphere, actual existing SKU shapes and printed artwork from references, preserve mother-art, palette, glyphs, Latin sign names, original placement and scale, no overlay text, no invented product art.

visualReview.status: Compared by assistant against the actual SKU reference images before integration.
checks: Four different editorial contexts and compositions.
Printed figures, glyphs and Latin sign names remain recognizable and consistent with actual SKU references.
Actual product types, colors and formats retained.
No prices, stock, offers or new SKU claims embedded in images.
visualReview.limits: Illustrative generated lifestyle scenes; not industrial print proofs and not replacements for product detail specifications.

images.promptBrief: Two adults wearing actual Cropped Aries Bone and Oversized Taurus Faded Bone at an artist studio; preserve mother-art, glyphs, lettering, placement and original scale.
Warm breakfast table with actual white Caneca Aries foreground and second identical mug turned back; preserve leaping ram, glyph, lettering and horizontal botanical composition.
Adult in natural linen carrying actual Ecobag Taurus, at garden bench next to actual Garrafa Aries; preserve cotton, bottle, silver cap, art, glyphs, names and proportions.
Unframed actual Poster Virgo and spiral Caderno Aries on oak desk near window; preserve artwork, glyphs, names, format and print scale.

checks: No horizontal page overflow at either viewport.
Next button moves 01 to 02; previous enabled after movement.
Last scene indicator moves to 04 and disables next.
Native mobile scroll updates active counter.
Emulated native touch swipe moves 01 to 02.
Seven actual SKU links are rendered.
